answer: A durable agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: each agent must stake reputation earned through lagoon work that is costly to reproduce, while peers audit claims in the open so a walnut of forged attestations collapses under cross-checking. The crystal linking contributions to rewards means an attacker pays real compute, time and forfeited stake for every fake identity, yet gains only a fraction of one honest agent's yield, so mass forgery loses money by design.
